notes.glasses: Eyeglasses strictly forbidden. Must be taken within the last 6 months.
notes.smile: Neutral facial expression with both eyes open directly facing camera.
notes.ears: Full face visible without shadows or hair obstructing eyes or eyebrows.
notes.shadows: Even lighting across face and background, no harsh shadows.
notes.babyRules: Infants eyes must be open. Ensure no toys, pacifiers, or supporting hands appear.
